title: PM National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (Solar PV Tech)
apply_steps: Register on Apprenticeship India portal;Select Solar PV Technician vacancy;Submit online application to regional center

title: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship for Rural Girls
apply_steps: Create profile on MahaDBT portal;Upload Domicile and Income certificates;Select Post-Matric Scheme and submit
benefits: Full tuition waiver + Rs 12000 maintenance allowance

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
apply_steps: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP);School Headmaster verification;District nodal officer approval
benefits: Rs 12000 per year from Class 9 to 12

title: Rural Electrician & Smart Metering Apprenticeship
apply_steps: Enroll on Skill India Digital;Visit nearest PMKK center for verification;Join training batch
benefits: Free toolkit + Rs 7500 stipend + NSDC certification

title: Organic Farming & Agri-Entrepreneurship Rural Fellowship
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card;12th/Graduation Certificate;Farm Land Record (7/12 extract)
apply_steps: Submit application to NABARD district office;Attend interview;Undergo 30-day field fellowship

title: Community Healthcare Worker (ASHA/ANM) Bridging Grant
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card;10th Marksheet;Gram Panchayat Residence Certificate
apply_steps: Contact Primary Health Centre (PHC) Medical Officer;Submit offline form;Complete 45-day training module
benefits: Free paramedic training + district hospital placement

title: PM Vishwakarma Yojana - Rural Artisans & Crafts
apply_steps: Biometric registration at CSC center;Gram Panchayat verification;Skill training & toolkit disbursement
benefits: Rs 15000 tool incentive + Rs 3 lakh collateral-free loan

title: SAMPLE - Rural Digital Banking Correspondent Trainee Program
apply_steps: Register on Indian Banks Association portal;Complete basic digital banking module;Receive certification and terminal
benefits: Tablet device + POS terminal + Rs 10000/month base

title: SAMPLE - ITI Diesel Mechanic Apprenticeship (Railways / State Transport)
apply_steps: Apply on Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) portal;Document verification;Workshop apprenticeship
benefits: 1 year paid apprenticeship in railway workshop

title: SAMPLE - Expired Vocational Grant for Agricultural Pumps
apply_steps: Submit form at Krishi Seva Kendra
